_why: THE RULE NAMES THE SAST SENTINEL MUST USE, declared once so the prompt and the gate cannot drift.

665f1a5 made a brownfield CVE advisory when the story did not introduce the package. It found dependency findings with the literal prefix 'dependency-cve-', read off one live run. The prompt's contract for that field was free-form ('rule': '...'), so nothing required the model to produce it: a different model, or a different draw, emitting 'cve-dependency-critical' would make every dependency CVE invisible to the advisory path and silently revert the gate to hard-stopping on pre-existing repository debt — the exact failure that fix exists to prevent.
The prompt is told to use this prefix and the gate reads the same file. Changing the value here changes both.
